jobs.title: Implementation Executive - AMER
jobs.description:
**Who are Evotix?**
===================

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue **Excellence**, show **Leadership**, deliver **Impact**, earn **Trust**, and **Empower** those around them.

**The Role**
============

The **Implementation Executive** is an entry-level remote role that supports the delivery of high-quality implementations of the Evotix 360 platform. Working closely with project and consulting teams, you will learn to configure and test solutions against defined requirements and help ensure project tasks are completed accurately and on time.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone looking to build a career in software, where you can strengthen your technical, analytical and client engagement skills. You will learn from experienced colleagues, contribute to customer delivery and help improve the consistency of our implementation approach.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Solution Configuration and Delivery**

* Configure the Evotix 360 solution in line with agreed requirements and specifications.
* Support the setup, testing and validation of solution components before go-live.
* Produce clear delivery documentation, including configuration specifications, UAT scripts and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Work with Project Management and consulting colleagues to deliver assigned tasks on time and to the expected standard.
* Outcome: Reliable, well-documented solution components that meet defined requirements and support a smooth implementation.

**Learning and Continuous Improvement**

* Complete onboarding and training pathways to build knowledge of the Evotix 360 platform and implementation methodology.
* Shadow experienced consultants during design sessions, customer interactions and troubleshooting activities.
* Ask questions, seek feedback and apply learning to improve the quality and consistency of your work.
* Contribute practical ideas that improve delivery tools, documentation and team practices.
* Outcome: Growing platform capability, increasing delivery independence and a positive contribution to team effectiveness.

**Professional Collaboration**

* Communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, asking clarifying questions where requirements are unclear.
* Investigate issues logically, document findings and seek guidance at the appropriate time.
* Support colleagues, share learning and contribute to a positive delivery culture.
* Outcome: Professional, dependable collaboration that builds stakeholder confidence and supports successful project delivery.

**What You Bring**
==================

**Essential**

* A strong interest in technical consulting or software delivery.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and a structured approach to completing tasks.
* Confident written and verbal communication, with the ability to work with technical and business stakeholders.
* Effective time management and the ability to handle multiple assigned tasks under direction.
* A collaborative mindset, willingness to learn and confidence asking for guidance when needed.

**Desirable**

* **No coding knowledge is required.**
* Familiarity with SaaS platforms, databases or process-driven business systems.
* Exposure to software configuration, testing, UAT or implementation documentation.
* Experience working in a fast-paced, scaling organisation or customer delivery environment.

*Please note that Evotix is unable to offer visa sponsorship. You must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application.*

**Interview Process**
=====================

We aim to keep our interview process transparent, fair, and respectful of your time. While steps may vary slightly by role, you can typically expect:

* **Initial chat:** A conversation with a member of our Talent team to learn more about your background, motivations, and answer any initial questions.
* **Hiring Manager interview:** A role-focused discussion exploring your experience, skills, and how you approach real-world scenarios relevant to the role.
* **Key Stakeholder interview:** A discussion with a senior member of the team that you will be working with should you join.
* **Offer:** If successful, we’ll move quickly to share an offer and next steps.

We’re happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process — just let us know what you need.

**Why join Evotix?**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a competitive base salary and company-based performance bonus.
* **Time to Recharge:** Unlimited Annual Leave because we trust you to balance your work and wellbeing.
* **Financial Future:** Generous tiered 401k plan that increases over time.
* **Support for You:** Access to our Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, and financial guidance.
* **Growth Opportunities:** Educational benefits to help you keep learning and growing.
* **Team Culture:** Regular team events, an inclusive environment, and a shared commitment to making an impact.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**  
If you’re a bold, results-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!  
  
*Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.*

jobs.title: Axxess Home Healthcare EMR Specialist & Trainer - Virtual
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**:

Washington Healthcare is seeking an experienced Axxess EMR Specialist to help optimize our utilization of the Axxess platform across our home healthcare operations. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with Axxess and a strong understanding of home healthcare workflows, regulatory compliance, and operational management.

This individual will work directly with our leadership, clinical, scheduling, billing, and administrative teams to improve operational efficiency, automate workflows, strengthen reporting capabilities, and maximize the return on our technology investment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Scheduling & Staffing:** Optimize HHA and nursing scheduling, recurring visits, caregiver assignments, availability, missed visits, and coverage management.
* **Reporting & Analytics:** Develop customized reporting processes for caregiver hours, patient census, productivity, utilization, missed visits, and operational performance.
* **Payroll & Timekeeping:** Improve caregiver hours tracking, payroll reporting, overtime monitoring, and reconciliation processes.
* **Compliance Management:** Utilize platform features to monitor credential expirations, documentation requirements, and regulatory compliance.
* **System Administration:** Optimize user permissions, system configurations, notifications, and available automation features.
* **Staff Training:** Conduct department-specific training sessions and develop standard operating procedures for consistent platform utilization.
* **Leadership Reporting:** Establish management dashboards and key performance indicators to support data-driven decision-making.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify underutilized Axxess features and recommend improvements to existing operational processes.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of three years of hands-on experience with Axxess Home Care or Axxess Home Health.
* Advanced knowledge of Axxess features, configurations, reporting, and administrative functions.
* Experience working within a home healthcare agency.
* Understanding of Medicaid billing, EVV, caregiver scheduling, and healthcare compliance.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and staff training skills.
* Experience developing standard operating procedures and implementing healthcare technology solutions.
* Previous experience as an Axxess trainer, implementation specialist, system administrator, or consultant is highly preferred.

Pay: $25.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 15.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Business / Implementation Analyst IV
jobs.description:
Overview:

LMI is seeking a **Business / Implementation Analyst** for a prospective VA OSP program, contingent upon contract award. These full-time positions will support standardized organizational assessments, implementation-gap analysis, targeted capacity improvement plans, and a repeatable process for tracking progress from findings to action.

Analysts will review qualitative and quantitative evidence, document workflows and implementation conditions, maintain assessment records, and help develop clear recommendations for government decision-makers. The work involves balancing consistent criteria with the realities of different organizational models and maturity levels.

This role works under the Business / Implementation Analyst Lead and with HCD, public-health, evaluation, and data colleagues. Successful candidates bring structured analysis, thoughtful stakeholder engagement, and clear writing to ambiguous operational challenges.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities:

* Review organizational program narratives, budgets, service plans, data summaries, policies, and workflow artifacts.
* Conduct or support structured assessment sessions using approved maturity rubrics and evidence expectations.
* Document organizational strengths, implementation gaps, workforce and governance needs, systemic barriers, and information gaps.
* Map current-state processes and identify changes needed to improve clarity, consistency, and operational readiness.
* Draft assessment findings and concise organization-specific capacity improvement plans.
* Define proposed next-state conditions, priority support needs, possible support resources, and expected evidence of progress.
* Track assessment findings, routing recommendations, client decisions, support actions, and reassessment points.
* Coordinate with evaluation and public-health SMEs to contextualize findings and avoid unsupported conclusions.
* Prepare decision briefs, requirements lists, action trackers, working-session notes, and presentation materials.
* Support recurring reassessments and aggregate lessons learned for continuous improvement.
* Apply quality, accessibility, confidentiality, and document-control standards to work products.
* Build and maintain structured evidence matrices that connect each finding to its source, assessment domain, maturity criterion, and proposed follow-up.
* Conduct root-cause analyses of workflow failures, staffing constraints, referral bottlenecks, reporting burden, and other implementation barriers identified during assessment.
* Draft clear support requirements that identify the affected audience, urgency, recommended delivery modality, expected outcome, and evidence of progress.
* Maintain a closed-loop action register that differentiates contractor recommendations from VA assignment, grant-management, and policy decisions.
* Coordinate data, evaluation, and public-health input to confirm that recommendations are feasible, context-sensitive, and supported by available evidence.
* Support peer review and quality-checking of assessment packages, maturity judgments, and improvement plans before leadership submission.
* Prepare complete assessment files with source inventories, documented evidence gaps, preliminary criteria interpretations, reviewer questions, and clearly labeled assumptions.
* Analyze how staffing changes, partner agreements, data practices, service definitions, or financial constraints affect a grantee's ability to sustain proposed operational changes.
* Develop concise capacity improvement plan entries with owners or recommended delivery resources, prerequisites, milestones, verifiable evidence of progress, and reassessment triggers.
* Support collaborative workshops by preparing evidence summaries, facilitating focused process walk-throughs, recording decisions, and distinguishing validated findings from future-state ideas.
* Maintain a prioritized work queue of assigned organizations and follow-up actions, coordinating with HCD, evaluation, and data leads to meet review and reporting milestones.

Qualifications:

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in business, public administration, operations, health services, social sciences, or related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
* 5+ years of relevant business analysis, implementation support, operations analysis, process improvement, or organizational assessment work.
* Experience analyzing documents and stakeholder inputs to develop requirements, workflows, findings, and recommended actions.
* Ability to use a structured rubric, maintain traceable evidence, and produce accurate professional deliverables.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and collaborative tracking tools.
* Ability to manage multiple assigned assessments and stakeholder interactions while meeting deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound professional judgment, and ability to work effectively with federal stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.
* Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust suitability determination; must meet applicable federal/VA background, security, privacy, training, and system-access requirements.
* Experience eliciting business rules, writing operational requirements, documenting decision criteria, and producing clear current-state and proposed-state process maps.
* Practical analytical skills in Excel, issue and action tracking, workflow mapping, document comparison, and structured written synthesis.
* Ability to identify the difference between implementation barriers, data-quality concerns, support needs, and matters requiring government judgment.
* Demonstrated capability to manage evidence versions, record review comments, and resolve documentation discrepancies under time-sensitive delivery cycles.
* Ability to interpret and compare operational source materials such as budgets, staffing plans, service tables, narratives, standard operating procedures, and performance reports.
* Experience preparing concise decision memoranda and action plans that distinguish the root cause of a problem from symptoms and identify measurable next-state conditions.
* Comfort working within defined governance boundaries, seeking senior or government review where policy, compliance, and grant-management judgments are required.

Desired:

* **Highly desirable:** Prior VA OSP/VHA business analysis, program operations, or improvement support experience.
* **Highly desirable:** Experience with federal grantee support, including onboarding, capacity-gap assessment, support-needs tracking, and follow-up improvement actions.
* Experience with maturity models, improvement plans, Lean process mapping, or requirements elicitation.
* Experience supporting qualitative interviews, consensus workshops, or reassessment cycles.
* Business analysis, Lean Six Sigma, or implementation-management credentials.
* Entry Certificate in Business Analysis (ECBA), Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA), PMI-PBA, or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.
* Familiarity with requirements traceability matrices, BPMN or comparable process notation, and organizational capability or maturity models.
* Experience with continuous-improvement work in federal, public-health, grant-recipient, or multisite service-delivery settings.
* Familiarity with requirements repositories, business-process mapping tools, workflow automation concepts, or simple data-validation checks that improve consistency.
* Experience documenting action ownership, deadlines, evidence of closure, and later verification in an organizational continuous-improvement setting.

Target salary range: $96,000 - $145,000

***Disclaimer:***

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Job Locations: US-Remote

jobs.title: Senior Business / Implementation Lead
jobs.description:
Overview:

LMI is seeking a **Business / Implementation Analyst Lead** to support a prospective VA OSP program, contingent upon contract award. This full-time key-personnel role turns human-centered discovery and operating evidence into practical assessment standards, implementation requirements, improvement pathways, and executive decision-support products.

The lead will manage a repeatable process for understanding organizational capacity and implementation conditions, including evidence collection, gap analysis, maturity judgments, prioritization, and reassessment. The work requires careful distinction among issues suitable for technical assistance, program management, data/tool improvements, or government-level decisions.

This position works closely with HCD, evaluation, public-health, data, and project-management personnel. Strong candidates are rigorous analysts who can define workable processes, guide a team of practitioners, and make nuanced organizational findings clear, traceable, and useful.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities:

Responsibilities

* Lead business and implementation analysis for the assessment-to-action framework, maturity rubric, and assessment operating procedures.
* Translate stakeholder interviews and discovery findings into workflow maps, process models, business requirements, and documented decision rules.
* Develop templates, evidence standards, quality controls, and consistent review practices for initial and recurring organizational assessments.
* Guide analysts in diagnosing staffing, governance, workflow, partnership, data, and implementation gaps from qualitative and quantitative evidence.
* Oversee practical, prioritized capacity improvement plans that connect current conditions to next-state goals and observable evidence of progress.
* Design and sustain a closed-loop process linking findings, routing recommendations, authorized support actions, monitoring, and reassessment.
* Distinguish contractor analysis and recommendations from policy, grant-management, and other decisions reserved for government personnel.
* Integrate evaluation-readiness criteria and public-health context into maturity findings without reducing complex conditions to a punitive score.
* Partner with data analysts to maintain assessment tracking, case traceability, and cross-portfolio trend summaries.
* Quality-review findings, improvement plans, process documentation, and decision-ready briefs for consistency and accessibility.
* Mentor business analysts and maintain a prioritized analysis backlog linked to the program schedule.
* Build an evidence-to-decision traceability model linking domain findings, root causes, recommended actions, government routing decisions, and reassessment milestones.
* Define practical analyst standard operating procedures for intake, evidence review, conflicting-information resolution, peer review, and release of final assessment findings.
* Lead calibration discussions across assessment teams to improve consistent interpretation of maturity levels while documenting necessary context-specific exceptions.
* Use process modeling, root-cause analysis, stakeholder matrices, and impact/effort prioritization to identify feasible improvements that are distinct from policy decisions.
* Translate recurring gaps into structured capability requirements, recommended support modalities, implementation dependencies, and outcome-oriented acceptance measures.
* Brief leadership on systemic barriers, unresolved evidence limitations, portfolio-wide opportunities, and tradeoffs between implementation readiness and evaluation readiness.
* Lead mapping of assessment domains to source documents, interview evidence, decision rules, expected outcomes, and government-approved maturity-stage transitions.
* Create analyst calibration exercises using representative or de-identified cases, documenting what constitutes sufficient evidence and when conflicting findings require escalation.
* Develop an assessment production workflow with intake criteria, analyst assignments, quality gates, specialist consultations, client review, disposition of comments, and reassessment scheduling.

Qualifications:

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in business, organizational development, public administration, health services, systems engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* 10+ years of experience in business analysis, implementation improvement, process redesign, organizational assessment, or federal advisory services.
* Experience leading analysis teams and converting complex discovery inputs into requirements, workflow diagrams, rubrics, and action plans.
* Ability to develop repeatable assessments and trace evidence to findings, recommendations, and evaluation or reassessment checkpoints.
* Proficiency with facilitated stakeholder engagement, process mapping, analytical writing, and Microsoft 365 collaboration tools.
* Strong quality-control discipline and skill in synthesizing ambiguous or conflicting evidence into defensible recommendations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound professional judgment, and ability to work effectively with federal stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.
* Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust suitability determination; must meet applicable federal/VA background, security, privacy, training, and system-access requirements.
* Advanced ability to elicit, validate, and document business requirements, process models, business rules, decision logic, and requirements traceability matrices.
* Practical fluency with root-cause techniques, BPMN-style workflow mapping, RACI/ownership models, prioritization frameworks, and structured quality reviews.
* Experience coaching analysts, setting review standards, resolving inconsistent assessment conclusions, and producing client-ready decision documentation.
* Proficiency with Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, SharePoint or comparable Microsoft 365 and process-mapping tools in distributed teams.
* Experience developing business analysis standards, analyst playbooks, decision matrices, and review procedures that remain usable across different staff, cohorts, and operational settings.
* Ability to lead structured root-cause and impact analysis while differentiating implementable contractor recommendations from grant-management or policy decisions reserved to government officials.

Desired:

* **Highly desirable:** Prior VA program support, especially VA OSP/VHA, involving organizational operations, analysis, or implementation improvement.
* **Highly desirable:** Experience supporting grantee management through evidence reviews, capacity assessments, grant-recipient improvement plans, and technical-assistance routing recommendations.
* Experience establishing organizational maturity models, readiness assessments, or continuous-improvement programs.
* CBAP, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent business/organizational analysis training.
* Experience integrating human-centered design and program evaluation into implementation planning.
* Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA), or Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt certification.
* Experience applying implementation science, organizational maturity models, service-design outputs, or federal grants operations to business improvement.
* Ability to design quality-control checklists and analyst playbooks that can be sustained across multiple grantee cohorts and staffing transitions.
* Experience facilitating cross-disciplinary adjudication of incomplete or inconsistent findings and documenting defensible decisions with explicit evidence limitations.

Target salary range: $117,000 - $155,000

***Disclaimer:***

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Job Locations: US-Remote

jobs.title: Manager, Implementation
jobs.description:
**About us**  
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.  
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.  
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.  
  
**Our people**  
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.  
  
**Our impact**  
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

**Who You Are :**

The Manager of Implementation is responsible for leading and inspiring the Implementation team. The Manager of Implementation is the key champion for ensuring HighLevel customers’ end-to-end lifecycle experience is exceptional. The goal is to maximize customer lifetime value through retention and own the “voice of customer” as part of HighLevel’s overall customers for life vision. The manager of Customer Success will be focused on ensuring the highest levels of customer success and end-user adoption as measured by retention, renewals and CLTV, and advocacy of HighLevel’s product and services. The Manager of Implementation is a central role raising the voice of customers to a roar within HighLevel utilizing internal “HealDesk'' processes and communications.  

**What You’ll Do:**

* Supervise a team of Implementation Representatives focused on solving customer issues and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction and retention and fostering a positive team culture. Accomplishes customer success human resource
* Manages employee recruitment, selection, training, scheduling, coaching, counseling, and discipline. Communicates job expectations, monitors performance, appraises contributions, plans compensation, and enforces policies.
* Help to develop a proactive approach to customer success by defining customer churn risk criteria
* Develop and lead proactive out-reach programs that drive greater adoption of new features and optimization of current customer implementations
* Facilitate industry-leading “voice of the customer” processes including feedback channels and continuous improvement methods to enhance customer experience.
* Conduct consistent and impactful performance conversations, conflict management and coaching sessions with team members and managers.
* Use quantitative and qualitative analysis to drive operational excellence in the areas of customer engagement

* Devise a customer contact methodology to monitor and improve renewal/retention rates
* Can include managing or engagement with enterprise accounts
* Ensure execution of customer journey touchpoints, including onboarding, business reviews, retention, upsells and other opportunities
* Coach team on customer success best practices and training
* Provide continuous knowledge growth opportunities for Highlevel features and products
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure visibility and alignment
* Managing customer complaints, CSAT results and relationships to assure customers satisfaction.
* Facilitate proper delegation to team members in the proper roles.
* Building SOPs, Playbooks and KPIs for Team and Department and report on KPI achievement
* Build out a road map for successful implementations and ongoing support of this process and product engagement for team
* Serve as an escalation point for critical recruiting issue resolution
* Serve as an escalation point for at risk customers to promote product and resources that will help them be successful
* Leverage analytics to review automations and internal processes are successful and continue adapting strategies for your Customer success team to use with customers
* Continued optimization of current process and future ideals

  

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of experience leading customer facing, SaaS teams (CSM, Onboarding or Account Management
* 3+ years experience managing and leading technical, customer-facing teams of 12+ individuals.
* Project management skills
* Leading a results driven team
* People manager at heart, you love mentoring, leading and contributing to the professional development of those around you
* Strong collaboration, time-management, influencing and prioritization skills are critical to the success of this role
* The ability to build and maintain relationships internally with team and with customers
* Excellent listening, presentation and communication skills at all levels
* Strong customer facing communication skills
* Demonstrated data driven approach to problem solving
* Must be a go-getter and not afraid to ask questions
* Must have basic computer and excel skills

The salary range for this position is **$70000- $90000 annually**

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, Payroll
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

This is an exciting opportunity to be a foundational member of Rippling’s Payroll Implementation team!

As a Product Specialist, Payroll, you will partner with our largest customers (US and Global) and see complex/unique situations. You will work with our customer’s HR and Finance departments to understand their requirements and guide them through GL, Taxes, Job Codes, Time & Attendance. You will also be the internal go-to for all things related to Rippling Payroll. This could include supporting new product/country launches, building internal training resources, and leading Office Hours.

The Payroll implementation team at Rippling is growing. This role offers a unique opportunity to not only work with our largest customers but also work cross-functionally to improve our product, enablement and customer experience.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Become an expert on Rippling’s Payroll products - You’ll be a go-to resource for our clients within 30 days and a Payroll subject matter expert for your Rippling colleagues within 60 days.
* Be a trusted implementation partner to our clients:
* + You’ll need to understand the client’s current Payroll and Accounting set up.
  + You’ll need to guide the customer through their Payroll and GL set up as well as related Time policies and Job Codes set up where applicable.
  + You’ll work closely with the Implementation Manager to ensure the client is set up for success.
* Partner with our Implementation and Product teams to evolve our process and product
* Develop and document Payroll implementation processes and best practices.
* Support new payroll-adjacent product launches and new country launches.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* A passion and curiosity for all things related to Payroll and GL.
* 4+ years of experience in payroll implementation. This role requires a strong understanding of the below:
* + Payroll, GL, Taxes, Job Codes, and Time Policies
* Strong project management and organizational skills: High attention to detail with excellent time management skills.
* Ability to manage client relationships: Strong communication and presentation skills
* Self-starter with a bias towards action, energized by a fast-paced environment and excited to build.

**Additional Information**

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy.*

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
75,600 - 113,400 USD per year(US Tier 2)

jobs.title: Oracle Fusion Implementation Lead - Grants Management

jobs.title: Director of Onboarding
jobs.description:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

End users enjoy a seamless, zero-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all-in-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and [solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

Order.co is looking for a Director of Onboarding to lead how our new customers change the way they buy, and how fast they get there. Onboarding is the first real experience a customer has with us after signing, and every week between contract close and activation is spend that hasn’t moved to Order.co yet. As we grow across our core, partner, and enterprise channels, we need a leader who can oversee multiple customer rollouts at once, with a small but mighty team, without letting speed or quality slip.

This is a leadership role with a broad mandate, and it comes as we reshape what onboarding means at Order.co. Getting a customer live is only the start: this role owns changing how the customer buys. You and your team will move each customer forward by setting milestones with their leadership, driving user change management, rolling out and training across their locations, and ushering them through to fully ramped spend. You will partner closely with a dedicated setup team to ensure the customer experiences one seamless setup. You will own the setup & onboarding strategy and delivery across all three channels and lead a diverse team including individual contributors, team leads, and future people managers. Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, you will set the standard for what onboarding looks like at Order.co.

**What you’ll do**

* **Lead and develop the team.** Coach team members and leaders, establish clear responsibilities and career paths, and allocate projects based on capacity, complexity, and individual strengths.
* **Build scalable onboarding programs.** Define implementation tiers, milestones, and delivery standards across core, partner, and enterprise channels. Clarify ownership across Onboarding, Account Management, and Customer Success.
* **Drive customer rollout and change management.** Guide the team in building mutual success plans with clear dates, owners, and location rollout schedules. Engage executive sponsors, develop customer champions, and address missed commitments early.
* **Make adoption stick.** Build training and communication programs for admins, approvers, and requesters across hundreds of locations. Help customers transition purchasing from legacy channels to Order.co and measure success through sustained usage.
* **Own onboarding performance.** Track and improve time to activation against tier-specific SLAs, the share of booked spend reached within four months, location and user adoption, and CSAT.
* **Create seamless transitions.** Establish clear handoffs from Sales and Partnerships, coordinate configuration delivery with Operations, and transition customers to Customer Success once they meet defined onboarding exit criteria.
* **Guide the configuration transition.** Partner with Operations to define ownership, handoff requirements, and turnaround times as catalog setup, GL coding, spend history, and other configuration work move out of Onboarding.
* **Resolve complex projects.** Serve as the escalation point for at-risk implementations, particularly enterprise deployments, and step in directly when needed.
* **Improve how we work.** Turn customer and team insights into process improvements and Product priorities. Use AI and automation to reduce manual work, and carry improvements through rollout, adoption, and standardization.

**What we’re looking for**

* 5+ years of experience in implementation, customer success, or professional services in SaaS, eCommerce, or B2B, including 3+ years leading teams. Experience managing team leads or managers is a strong plus.
* Experience overseeing multiple concurrent implementations, from high-velocity SMB onboarding to complex enterprise and partner-led deployments.
* A track record of driving adoption across distributed, multi-location businesses through rollout planning, role-based training, and change management.
* The credibility to engage customer executives, hold stakeholders accountable, and influence cross-functional partners you don’t directly manage.
* Experience using data to improve delivery speed, time to value, adoption, and customer satisfaction while supporting a strong team culture.
* A builder’s mindset, with experience creating scalable processes, playbooks, and documentation and guiding teams through change.
* Hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve onboarding, or a clear perspective on where they can reduce manual work.
* Strong written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and the organization to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience in procurement, purchase-to-pay, or supply chain, and familiarity with tools such as Asana, are a plus.

**What you’ll receive**

* A competitive compensation package including base as well as stock options
* The opportunity to grow within the overall Customer Success organization
* Employer-sponsored 401(k) including an employer match
* The opportunity to develop and perform in a fast-paced environment alongside a stellar team
* Flexible time off and remote work policies
* Robust medical, dental, vision, and wellness benefits
* Generous leave policies and support for new and current parents
* The anticipated annual compensation for this role is $165,000 - $185,000 OTE. Actual compensation and title will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skills.

jobs.title: Brand Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Franchise FastLane is the #1 Franchise Sales Organization in the country and a multi-time Inc. 5000 honoree.

We are a franchise growth partner that guides entrepreneurs and founders from concept to exit. We help individuals find the right brand to own, help founders build franchise systems that others can own, and give established franchisors the strategy, talent, and technology to expand with confidence.

One team, one system, and a shared focus on building lasting enterprise value.

**The Role:**

The Brand Onboarding Specialist owns the end-to-end onboarding and launch process for new franchise brands entering the Franchise FastLane platform.

This role serves as the central point of coordination between franchisors and internal Sales, Marketing, Operations, Compliance, and Leadership teams. The Brand Onboarding Specialist is responsible for ensuring every brand is fully prepared, properly positioned, operationally ready, and launched successfully.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously. They are skilled at gathering complex information, creating structure, driving accountability, and ensuring projects move forward efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Brand Onboarding & Launch Management***

· Take ownership of new franchise brands immediately following contract execution and internal handoff.

· Serve as the primary point of contact for franchisors throughout the onboarding process.

· Lead onboarding kickoff meetings and establish launch timelines, deliverables, expectations, and responsibilities.

· Maintain the master onboarding plan and ensure all stakeholders meet agreed-upon deadlines.

· Identify onboarding risks, missing information, and launch barriers and drive timely resolution.

***Brand Information & Documentation Management***

· Collect, organize, and maintain required brand information, documentation, and launch assets.

· Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and accessible to internal stakeholders.

· Coordinate collection of franchise-related materials, including:

o Current FDD and franchise agreements

o Financial performance representations (Item 19)

o Franchise fees and investment information

o Territory requirements and availability

o Franchisee validation contacts

o Candidate qualification criteria

o Discovery and sales process information

o Marketing assets and brand materials

· Escalate legal or compliance-related questions to appropriate internal leaders or franchise counsel.

***Coordinate Development of the Internal Brand Playbook***

· Coordinate the development of internal brand resources used by Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams.

· Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure brand positioning, candidate profiles, competitive differentiators, candidate journey information, and consultant-facing resources are accurately documented.

· Ensure internal teams have the information necessary to confidently represent and support each brand.

***Marketing Launch Readiness***

· Partner with Marketing to ensure launch requirements are completed and approved on schedule.

· Coordinate collection and delivery of required inputs for:

o Landing pages

o CRM campaign setup

o Lead routing

o Marketing assets

o Consultant-facing materials

o Tracking and attribution requirements

· Ensure marketing readiness remains aligned with overall launch timelines.

***Sales Launch Readiness***

· Coordinate sales readiness activities prior to launch.

· Schedule brand training sessions and franchisor introductions.

· Confirm lead routing, CRM configuration, and availability of sales materials.

· Track and resolve outstanding questions, action items, and launch dependencies.

· Ensure development teams are prepared to represent brands accurately and confidently before launch.

***Cross-Functional Launch Coordination***

· Serve as the primary coordinator across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and franchisor teams.

· Maintain visibility into timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and outstanding items.

· Facilitate communication and accountability among stakeholders.

· Escalate issues requiring leadership support or intervention.

· Conduct formal launch readiness reviews prior to activation.

· Validate that operational, sales, marketing, and brand requirements have been completed.

· Assess launch risks and provide launch recommendations to leadership.

***Post-Launch Transition***

· Transfer documentation, contacts, commitments, and relationship history.

· Document outstanding items and ensure appropriate ownership.

· Support resolution of onboarding-related issues identified immediately following launch.

***Process Improvement & Optimization***

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist (Google Marketing Tools and Tracking)
jobs.description:
Do you love working in the digital marketing industry?

Do you enjoy the technical side of marketing (setting up Google Tag Manager containers, wiring up conversion tracking, and making sure every call, form fill, and purchase gets counted before a single ad dollar is spent)?

If you answered YES to these questions and you are:

* someone who loves building things right the first time (i.e., clean tag setups, clear naming conventions and solid documentation);
* highly organized and detail-obsessed, the kind of person who notices when a conversion fires twice;
* great at working with clients, and can explain technical steps in plain, friendly language;
* driven by opportunities to learn more and grow your skills and experiences, and by contributing successes for the team and the clients;
* always curious about the world around you, having an elaborate growth mindset;

Read on, as we are looking for a "**Tracking & Tagging Wizard**", and this role may be just for you.

**OUR COMPANY**

**Fast + Light** is one of the fastest growing digital marketing agencies in and out of Los Angeles. We've been in business as an agency for over 10 years, and we aim to guide our clients towards their measurable success. Our company operates on not only "fixing", but also into helping our clients understand the mechanics on how we actually bring in sales into their company.

Think of us as mechanics for their revenue engine.

Only, we don't just sell the dream and shiny new parts - we guide our clients through the technical stuff and give the tools to fix the leaky sales funnel.

Tactics and methods in the digital marketing world constantly change, but our client-first results-driven business principles don't.

**THE POSITION**

**Fast + Light** is seeking a detail-oriented and technically sharp **Onboarding & Tracking Specialist with expertise in Google Tag Manager and Tracking Setup**, who can get our new clients set up correctly from day one so our ads team can launch with confidence.

As you work with a team that brings scalable success to some of the top names in health and wellness, fashion and home goods, as well as local businesses, selling products, services, and online courses through various social media platforms and Google advertising, your key responsibilities to fulfill this position are:

* Leading new clients through onboarding: gathering account access, assets and business information, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between contract signing and campaign launch;
* Setting up, auditing, and fixing tracking (Google Tag Manager containers, GA4 properties, Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel and Conversions API) so every key action is measured accurately;
* Documenting each client's setup and handing it off cleanly to our media buyers and account managers.

One of our visions as a company is to create a world where businesses-- however big or small, and as long as they have the idea and run with the same passion as ours-- get the chance to grow profitably as they help people through their products and/or services.

As we help them grow, we help their customers get products and/or services that they need, and at the same time contribute creating more jobs as our clients' businesses flourish to growth, scalability, and, above all, profitability. The work you'll contribute to our team is greatly valued as we recognize that this will help us achieve these goals with our clients.

Oh! Also before we forget, this is a **part-time position that can grow into a full-time** position quickly. And, you can fulfill your work at the comfort of your own home or literally anywhere around the world as we follow a **fully remote** working location.

We are a relaxed and friendly team, with a fun and casual relationship with most of our clients, though performance and passion for the craft of online advertising is at the core of everything we do. No matter what your background is, if you are willing to bring the wins and successes we aim for our clients, and willing to learn the ins and outs of the industry, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

**THE PREREQUISITES**

Before anything else, we'd like to give you a sneak-peek of the actual responsibilities of the role (aside from the aforementioned):

* Run onboarding calls to collect logins, permissions and brand assets, and follow up until everything is in.
* Secure and organize access to Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Google Merchant Center, Meta Business Manager and the client's website or e-commerce platform (e.g., Shopify, WordPress).
* Create new GTM containers or audit existing ones, implement and organize tags, triggers, and variables using clear naming conventions.
* Set up GA4 properties, data streams and key events, and link GA4 with Google Ads and Search Console.
* Implement conversion tracking for form submissions, purchases, phone calls, button clicks and chats, including Enhanced Conversions where applicable.
* Install and verify the Meta Pixel and Conversions API, plus other platform tags as needed (e.g., Microsoft UET, TikTok, LinkedIn).
* Configure call tracking (e.g., CallRail, WhatConverts) and connect it to Google Ads and GA4.
* Work with data events and ecommerce tracking, and set up cross-domain tracking where needed.
* QA every setup before launch using GTM Preview/Tag Assistant, GA4 DebugView and Meta Events Manager.
* Set up consent mode and cookie-consent tools where a client requires them.
* Maintain onboarding checklists, SOPs, and per-client tracking documentation, and troubleshoot tracking issues after launch.
* Keep media buyers, creatives and account managers updated on each client's onboarding status.
* Maintaining tracking events and resolve ongoing tracking issues and errors

Our dream candidate would be someone who:

* Has at least 2 years of hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager and GA4, ideally within a digital marketing agency
* Has proven experience setting up conversion tracking for Google Ads and Meta Ads (forms, calls, purchases)
* Has a solid understanding of the tags, triggers, variables, and debugging tools
* Is familiar with ad account structures, user access and permissions in Google Ads Manager (MCC) and Meta Business Manager
* Is comfortable working inside website platforms such as Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Wix or Squarespace, etc.
* Has strong organizational skills and can handle several client onboardings at the same time
* Has a keen eye and high attention to detail
* Has strong verbal and written communication skills, and is comfortable speaking with clients
* Has the ability work efficiently remotely and can manage/track time and tasks accordingly
* Has a passion for learning and staying at the forefront of digital marketing/advertising
* Is enthusiastic, passionate, and committed

Although not required, it would be a plus advantage to have the following:

* Bachelor's degree
* Google Analytics and/or Google Ads Certification
* Experience with server-side tracking (e.g., GTM server container, Stape)
* Basic HTML/JavaScript knowledge for custom tags and triggers
* Experience with Google Consent Mode v2 and cookie-consent platforms
* Experience building reporting dashboards (e.g., Looker Studio)
* Experience with CRMs and their integrations (e.g., GoHighLevel, HubSpot)

**THE COVERAGE**

**Job Type:** Part-time, Full-time

**Schedule:** 9AM to 5PM PST, Mondays to Fridays

**Experience:** Google Tag Manager & Tracking Setup (required)

**Work Location:** Fully Remote

**Salary:** Under negotiable terms

**INTERESTED TO APPLY?**

Send in the following files/documents so we can kick-start your hiring process:

* Updated resume or curriculum vitae
* Cover Letter
* 2-minute video introducing yourself
* A sample of a tracking setup you've done (screenshots, a short screen-recording walkthrough or a brief write-up)

Pay: $10.00 - $15.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 8.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

--------------------------

**Together, we innovate for a stronger Colorado**

The work of employees at the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT) is challenging and diverse because the needs of agencies, customers and Coloradans constantly evolve. But our focus never changes: improve the lives of all Coloradans through innovation and collaboration. We're building one of the nation's leading government IT organizations by reimagining how we support agencies, building first-of-their-kind applications, and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture, together. Join us in the important work of providing equitable access to services.

  
  
Watch this video to learn more about how we're Serving People. Serving Colorado.

**Description of Job**
----------------------

**TERM LIMITED POSITION:** This position is term limited with an anticipated end date of approximately one year from the date of hire. This position is eligible for State employee benefits and may be extended as the situation warrants. This **video** explains the many benefits of working at the State of Colorado on a term limited basis**.**

  
  

**IMPORTANT NOTE:** Please review your application to ensure completion. For the most equitable applicant experience, OIT’s hiring team considers only the contents of your application to review your qualifications. Please do not include any attachments (such as resume or cover letter) with your application as these items are not used by OIT’s hiring team.

  
  
  

As our new IT Onboarding Specialist you will provide end-to-end coordination of technology onboarding services for new state employees.

  
  

You will act as the primary coordination point between hiring managers and OIT fulfillment teams, simplifying the onboarding experience by allowing managers to initiate a single onboarding request rather than independently navigating OIT’s internal technology teams, processes, tickets, and dependencies.

  
  

You will be accountable for maintaining visibility across the complete OIT onboarding journey, facilitating the work necessary to fulfill the onboarding request, identifying and addressing coordination gaps, and ensuring visibility into whether required technology services will be ready for the employee’s start date.

  
  
  

Essential Functions:

  
  

Receives and validates onboarding requests, including employee start date, work location, equipment needs, access requirements, applications, and other required technology services.

  
  

Determines the OIT fulfillment activities required to support the onboarding request.

Facilitates initiation of the appropriate OIT tickets, tasks, requests, and approvals required to complete the onboarding wherever processes allow.

  
  

Maintains an end-to-end view of the onboarding request while individual fulfillment activities are completed across OIT teams.

  
  

Tracks ownership, status, dependencies, expected completion dates, and identified risks associated with required onboarding activities.

  
  

Coordinates dependencies across identity, access, equipment, applications, network services, and other OIT services.

  
  

Serves as the primary OIT coordination contact for the hiring manager throughout the onboarding process.

  
  

Proactively identifies missing information, stalled activities, unresolved dependencies, and other conditions that could affect employee readiness.

  
  

Requests status, accountable ownership, and expected resolution or completion dates from fulfillment teams when necessary.

  
  

Escalates unresolved issues and risks through established OIT operational and leadership channels.

  
  

Verifies completion of required onboarding activities and confirms technology readiness before the onboarding request is closed.

  
  

Identifies recurring barriers, exceptions, and process failures and provides those findings to appropriate service owners and leadership to support continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment & Appeal Rights**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant - FP&A (Product Implementation) Remote — Full Time Europe
jobs.description:
Drivetrain is on a mission to empower businesses to make better decisions. Our financial planning & decision-making platform helps companies scale and achieve their targets predictably.

  
  

Drivetrain is a remote-first company headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. Founded in 2021 by a couple of ex-Googlers, Drivetrain is a fast-growing company on a trajectory for success with backing from leading venture capital firms.

  
  

**Drivetrain provides a great culture for its employees to thrive in and be happy.**

  

**Remote-friendly:** Drivetrain brings together the best and the brightest, no matter where they are and provides them a great degree of autonomy. We trust our people.

**️ Open & transparent:** We know that when our creators have access to all the information they need, their best work will emerge.

**Idea-friendly:** We provide an environment to explore new ideas, to take risks, to make mistakes, and to learn, so you can succeed. Anyone in the company can come up with great ideas and become a catalyst for positive change. We let the best ideas win.

**Customer-centric:** We follow a product-led growth strategy, continuously learning from our customers and collaborating to build the amazing software that Drivetrain is.

  

**About the role**

  

**At** **Drivetrain.ai****,** we don’t just sell a vision; we build it. We are looking for a Solutions Consultant who is technically adept and financially fluent to partner with our Account Executives and Data Analyst teams. In this role, you will go deep into the "how"—architecting data structures, building complex financial models, and demonstrating the tangible value of Drivetrain to CFOs and Finance leaders.

  

**What You’ll Do**

  

**Architect & Build Solutions:** Move beyond high-level strategy to hands-on execution.

You will design, model, and configure proof-of-concepts and pilot implementations within Drivetrain to solve specific financial pain points.

  

**Serve the Office of the CFO:** Act as a trusted advisor to CFOs and VPs of Finance. You will translate their complex business requirements—from FP&A and consolidation to scenario planning—into robust technical logic.

  

**Data Architecture & Integration:** Leverage your exposure to data architecture to design scalable data models. You will guide prospects on how to best structure their financial and operational data (ERP, CRM, HRIS) for optimal performance within Drivetrain.

  

**Technical Workshops:** Lead deep-dive technical workshops where you define business logic, map data flows, and build customized models live to prove the platform’s value.

  

**Strategic Discovery:** Conduct technical discovery sessions to uncover the limitations of a prospect’s current architecture (e.g., rigid Excel sheets, legacy EPMs) and map out a modern, data-driven planning infrastructure.

  

**Cross-Functional Feedback:** Act as the "voice of the implementation" to Product and Engineering, providing detailed feedback on backend data handling, modeling flexibility, and calculation engine performance based on real-world client scenarios.

  

**Who You Are**

  

**Finance Background (CPA Preferred):** You speak the language of finance fluently. A background as a CPA, or significant experience in FP&A/Corporate Finance, is strongly preferred.

You understand the nuances of the three financial statements, revenue recognition, and driver-based planning.

  

**Implementation Heavy:** You are not afraid to get your hands dirty with data. You have a track record of actually building models, not just presenting slides. You enjoy the puzzle of translating a messy spreadsheet into a clean, multidimensional model.

  

**Data Architecture Exposure:** You have a working knowledge of how data is stored and structured (Schemas, Dimensions, Cubes). You understand the implications of data granularity and hierarchy management on system performance.

  

**EPM Expertise:** Deep modeling experience in at least one major EPM product is required (e.g., Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, TM1/Planning Analytics, Planful, Vena, Jedox, Abacum, Runway, etc.). You understand the mechanics of multidimensional planning.

  

**Business Acumen:** You can command a room of C-level executives. You possess the empathy to understand their stress points and the technical authority to prescribe the cure.

  

**Agile & Technical:** You are comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment where you may need to troubleshoot a data integration one hour and present a strategic roadmap to a CFO the next.

  

**Qualifications**

  

BA/BS degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.

CPA or CA designation is highly preferred.

3+ years of experience in EPM implementation, Sales Engineering, or Technical Finance roles.

jobs.title: SaaS Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

**Location: UK, Poland or Portugal | Travel: 10–15% | Full-time**

We’re looking for an experienced **SaaS Implementation Project Manager** to lead customer implementations across Varian’s oncology software portfolio throughout EMEA.

This is a customer-facing role where you’ll own complex SaaS implementations from kick-off through to go-live, bringing together customers, Implementation Engineers and cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery.

You won’t perform the technical installation yourself. Instead, you’ll make sure the customer, technology, resources, risks, decisions and timelines all come together successfully.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Lead SaaS implementation projects from kick-off to go-live.
* Manage project plans, milestones, resources, dependencies and Statements of Work.
* Act as the primary project contact for customers across clinical, IT and operational teams.
* Identify risks early, manage issues and drive escalations through to resolution.
* Coordinate customer onboarding and implementation readiness.
* Partner with SaaS Implementation Engineers and teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Service.
* Lead project meetings, ensuring clear decisions, actions, owners and deadlines.
* Manage multiple customer projects across EMEA while maintaining clear communication and delivery visibility.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* Experience managing SaaS, cloud or enterprise software implementations.
* Strong customer-facing project management experience.
* Excellent stakeholder, risk and project governance skills.
* Confidence coordinating technical and non-technical teams.
* The ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Strong communication skills, including the confidence to navigate challenging customer conversations.
* Experience within healthcare, oncology or another regulated environment would be an advantage, but isn’t essential.

**Location & languages**
------------------------

We welcome applications from candidates based in Portugal, Poland & the UK, subject to local employing arrangements. **Fluent English is essential**, and **Spanish, Portuguese or Polish** language skills would be particularly valuable.

You should also be comfortable travelling approximately **10–15% across the region**.

**Why join us?**
----------------

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of healthcare, technology and customer delivery, leading SaaS implementations that support oncology organisations across Europe. If you enjoy bringing structure to complexity, building strong customer relationships and driving technology projects through to successful go-live, we’d love to hear from you

We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
